author: @Ripple
title: Ripple puts Stripe's Privy wallets on the XRP Ledger
excerpt:
Broadening access to XRPL, from everyday payments to agentic commerce.

We’re partnering with @privy_io, a Stripe company, to bring embedded wallets to the XRP Ledger. Developers will be able to build payment experiences with XRP, RLUSD and other digital assets on XRPL directly into their products, without requiring users to manage their own keys.

The integration will also enable agentic commerce through programmable wallets that let AI agents hold funds and transact, including through x402 payments.

Built for payments, XRPL is already powering the next wave of commerce. To date, it has processed 13M agent payments, which now account for roughly 25% of network activity.

author: @Nasdaq
title: Nasdaq plans 23-hour, five-day trading for its flagship market
excerpt:
Over the last decade, global investor demand for U.S. equities has increased and investors have increasingly shown that they want access to U.S. markets during their local trading hours. Nasdaq is preparing to meet this demand by moving its flagship market, the Nasdaq Stock Market, to be open for trading 23 hours a day, 5 days a week.

Recently, leaders from our North American Markets team explored how exchange infrastructure, market safeguards, and regulatory oversight will support expanded global access, and how trading institutions can prepare for launch. Watch the video: https://t.co/9ruZc4iFAg

title: OpenAI: employee hid a recording device; FBI arrested him
excerpt:
We discovered a sophisticated recording device that was hidden inside one of our offices. We used our models to understand the device and where it had come from, identifying that a specific employee had planted it a few days earlier. We referred the matter to the FBI, and we’re grateful to the agents and prosecutors who moved quickly to make an arrest. The FBI’s investigation is ongoing and we will continue to support their work.

At this time, we have no indications of this individual inappropriately accessing or exfiltrating model weights, source code, or customer data. The employee was terminated.
